protocolName: Contrarian self-media argument: claim-scope, visual-aid, and opening-to-closing closure
rationale: The probe found a single continuous whiteboard argument whose meaning is carried jointly by speech/SRT, burned emphasis captions, a sub-second metrics collage, marker gestures, handwritten list/curve diagrams, qualifications, and a closing boundary that narrows the hook. Capture therefore targets each semantic turn and the global relations, while preserving author claims as claims, resolving carrier conflicts where possible, and refusing to treat technical shots as semantic scenes.

knowledgeUnitFields.name: argumentNodeRole
knowledgeUnitFields.reason: The cognitive change depends on separating hook, rationale, hypothetical example, qualification, counterargument, permitted action, and prohibited action.

knowledgeUnitFields.name: claimScopeAndTruthStatus
knowledgeUnitFields.reason: Universal and causal claims are asserted without demonstrated audits or platform data and must not become raw facts.

knowledgeUnitFields.name: authorProvidedSupportOrExample
knowledgeUnitFields.reason: The profile test and million-follower/likes scenario are author-provided reasoning, not external proof.

knowledgeUnitFields.name: visualArgumentAid
knowledgeUnitFields.reason: The insert, whiteboard grouping, yellow caption emphasis, pointing, and curve drawings carry non-SRT information.

knowledgeUnitFields.name: openingClosingFunction
knowledgeUnitFields.reason: The closing assistance/substitution boundary narrows the opening absolute ban and must survive in both relations and prose.

knowledgeUnitFields.name: referentAndIdentityBoundary
knowledgeUnitFields.reason: The recurring masked speaker, metrics insert, and carrier-conflicted closing self-label have evidence-traceable referents but do not establish literal personal/platform identity.

knowledgeUnitFields.name: carrierConflictResolution
knowledgeUnitFields.reason: CUE-001 is consequentially garbled and cannot be silently repaired; abbreviation spacing also needs raw-form preservation.

knowledgeUnitFields.name: technicalSegmentationVersusSemanticContinuity
knowledgeUnitFields.reason: Eleven technical segments mostly remain one whiteboard lesson and cannot be upgraded to scene/edit count.

knowledgeUnitFields.name: scopedAbsenceAndUnknown
knowledgeUnitFields.reason: Named tool/platform/access/price and empirical proof are decision boundaries sought across the full timeline but not observed; non-speech audio role also remains unknown.

captureActions.carrier: opening inserted collage, burned captions, masked presenter, and SRT/audible-speech conflict
captureActions.reason: The sub-second insert carries metrics and proof-like framing, while the first SRT fragment is unresolved and the hook must be paired with its later qualification.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Read only legible overlay counts/text and hook captions; distinguish insert labels from speech captions; preserve CUE-001's raw unresolved wording and the visible masked-presenter referent.

captureActions.carrier: burned captions, presenter pointing, and persistent whiteboard outline
captureActions.reason: The audience qualifier, promoter motive claim, generic product labels, and whiteboard grouping must remain separate from external truth.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Capture the qualifier, agent/skill/mini-program captions, yellow emphasis, and the board region the presenter points toward; confirm that no specific promoter/product identity becomes readable.

captureActions.carrier: burned captions, speech-linked whiteboard list, and gesture sequence
captureActions.reason: The two-branch profile-data test and its unsupported absolute extension are core argument structure.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Capture separate poor-data and good-data branches, the absolute not-AI authorship wording, and the continuous board/presenter setup across several technical boundaries.

captureActions.carrier: burned captions, whiteboard headings, and presenter gesture
captureActions.reason: The best-topic action, one-click rejection, account specificity, and training overhead form a contrast that a summary could flatten.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Read the captioned nearest-to-viral answer, one-click promise rejection, IP/AI abbreviations, and any legible board mapping without inventing a purchase/configuration workflow.

captureActions.carrier: burned captions, persistent whiteboard, and semantic-continuity boundary
captureActions.reason: Traffic irregularity, limited reproducibility, and empathy claims are sequential conditions on the strategy, not independent scene changes.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Capture causal/qualifying connectors, emphasized words such as 不可复制 and 人类的蔑视, and confirm continuity of presenter/board across the long SHOT-008 segment.

captureActions.carrier: burned captions, numeric speech example, and whiteboard decline marks
captureActions.reason: The not-total-ban qualifier, undefined 60-point scale, audience split, and 1,000/1,000,000/50,000/3,000 numerical scenario must be exact and provenance-bounded.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Read all high-impact numbers and qualifier captions; capture the board marks before and after the presenter explains falling weight; verify no platform identity or analytics screen appears.

captureActions.carrier: motion-dependent whiteboard curve drawing, pointing sequence, and burned captions
captureActions.reason: The visual contrast between a slow rising curve and sudden jump supports the author's account-launch model and cannot be proven by one midpoint.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Capture before/during/after diagram states and captioned persistence counterargument; distinguish visible diagram illustration from empirical account evidence.

captureActions.carrier: closing burned captions, presenter self-label, and opening-closing semantic relation
captureActions.reason: The final assistance/substitution boundary narrows the hook and the self-label resolves only the presentational referent, not literal identity.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Read permitted knowledge-gap/brainstorming uses, prohibited one-click script-to-filming use, and the carrier-conflicted self-label (burned 人类最强编导 versus SRT/machine-audition 人类智商编导) followed by 下课; compare directly with the opening ban.

captureActions.carrier: technical shot-boundary neighborhoods versus recurring presenter, clothing, board, room, and camera axis
captureActions.reason: The source's 11 technical segments must not become a semantic-scene or edit count; paired boundary frames test continuity/discontinuity.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Compare the same board, room, costume, presenter, and camera axis on both sides of boundaries; preserve hidden-edit uncertainty even when semantic continuity is observed.

captureActions.carrier: full-timeline speech/SRT, burned captions, opening insert, whiteboard, and visible environment for bounded absence claims
captureActions.reason: Specific tool/platform/access/price/account/region/support identities and empirical workflow proof would materially change the viewer's decision but were not observed in the probe's full evidence-pack sweep.
captureActions.expectedObservation: Seek named product/platform, price, access path, account/region/support condition, analytics workflow, or empirical proof in every plausible carrier; conclude only not observed in the inspected full timeline if none appears, citing this action plus the complete cue/dense sweep.

stoppingRules: Every critical question CQ-01 through CQ-17 is answered or explicitly unknown with a bounded evidence scope.
Every meaning change MC-01 through MC-12 is represented by at least one final knowledge unit.
Every carrier CAR-01 through CAR-10 is inspected; non-speech audio remains explicitly unknown unless stronger audio evidence becomes available.
All OCR-requested frames are processed by macOS Vision OCR and high-impact accepted rows are checked against their source frames.
The opening metrics collage is read conservatively and its source/platform/authenticity remain unknown.
The carrier conflict ledger preserves both CUE-001's unresolved opening fragment and the closing 最强编导 versus 智商编导 disagreement, with every raw form traceable.
The opening prohibition and closing assistance/substitution boundary appear as distinct units connected by an evidenced relation.
The masked presenter, opening insert, and whiteboard receive explicit referent relations without literal identity overclaim.
Technical shot segments are compared at their boundaries and are not reported as semantic-scene/edit count; hidden edits remain unknown.
Full-timeline absence statements name the 0-156.367 second scope, carriers checked, and items sought.
No relation uses a self-edge; composite ideas are split into distinct semantic nodes.
The meta-gate finds no uninspected available carrier, meaning change, critical question, or required relation.
declaredUnknowns: Exact initial spoken phrase corresponding to the garbled first clause of CUE-001.
Carrier-unified wording of the closing self-label; burned caption says 人类最强编导 while SRT and machine audition say 人类智商编导.
Source platform, account ownership, dates, authenticity, and attribution of opening performance metrics.
Literal personal identity of the masked presenter and authorization/provenance of the mask styling.
Independent semantic role of music or sound effects in the continuous AAC stream.
Many small handwritten whiteboard words obscured by scale, low contrast, or the presenter.
Named AI product/platform, price, access path, account requirement, region, and support/responsibility entity.
Empirical truth of universal or causal author claims about promoters, real bloggers, AI quality, platform weight, or account launch.
Whether hidden edits occur within the semantically continuous whiteboard setup.
